Ten starter SKU labels

Use only with a NEW empty inventory or after confirming that SKUs 000001–000010 are all unused. These labels create real inventory numbers when photographed and imported. Use different labels for existing SKUs.

Take at least three garment photos, then photograph its matching marker as a separate LAST image. Repeat for each garment. Keep the marker sharp, upright and free from glare.

Print from your browser with Ctrl+P. Use plain white paper, 100% scale, and turn off browser headers/footers. Cut around the dashed lines, keeping the white QR border. This file works offline and needs no sign-in.

QR payloads are BC-000001–BC-000010; default inventory SKUs normalize to 000001–000010. Match any customized SKU settings. Keep the white border around each QR code when cutting.
